data.summary: Growth-oriented IT professional with 5 years of overall experience and 4+ years on Microsoft Power Platform, delivering enterprise applications, automations, and integrations. Strong hands-on experience with Microsoft Copilot Studio, Power Apps, Power Automate, Dataverse, and enterprise system connectivity using APIs and Azure services. Experienced in solution packaging, governance, and CI/CD pipelines with Azure DevOps.

responsibilities: Developed enterprise Canvas Apps with modular architecture, reusable components, and

Designed Copilot Studio bots with topic design, generative answers, Dataverse/SharePoint
Implemented ALM using managed solutions, environment variables, and Azure DevOps

raw_sections.summary: Professional Summary Growth-oriented IT professional with 5 years of overall experience and 4+ years on Microsoft Power Platform, delivering enterprise applications, automations, and integrations. Strong hands-on experience with Microsoft Copilot Studio, Power Apps, Power Automate, Dataverse, and enterprise system connectivity using APIs and Azure services. Experienced in solution packaging, governance, and CI/CD pipelines with Azure DevOps.
raw_sections.skills:
Core Skills - Microsoft Copilot Studio (Power Virtual Agents), Prompt Engineering, Generative Answers
Power Apps (Canvas & Model-Driven), Power Fx, Component Libraries, Responsive UX
Power Automate (Cloud & Desktop), Webhooks, HTTP Connectors, Child Flows, Error Handling
Dataverse, SharePoint Online, Security Roles, Business Rules
REST APIs (including Microsoft Graph API), Azure Functions, Azure App Services, SQL Server, Stored Procedures
Programming: C# (basic), Python, JavaScript, PowerShell, SQL/T-SQL
ALM & DevOps: Solutions, Environment Variables, Connection References, PAC CLI, Azure DevOps Pipelines
Responsible AI Awareness, Governance, DLP Policies, CoE Starter Kit
Technical Skills - Power Platform: Power Apps, Power Automate, Power BI, Dataverse, Power Pages, AI Builder
Azure: Azure Functions, App Services, Azure SQL, Azure AD, Storage Accounts, Virtual Machines
Databases: SQL Server, SSMS, SSDT, SSIS, SSRS, SSAS
Web & APIs: RESTful Services, JSON, XML, JavaScript, jQuery, Bootstrap
Reporting: Power BI, SSRS, Tableau, QlikView, Crystal Reports
raw_sections.experience:
Professional Experience
HCL Technologies Ltd — Lead Engineer (Apr 2022 – Apr 2025) Project: ALLEGRO – SYNAPPS Integration (Synchrony) Role: Sr. Power Platform / MS Dynamics 365 Developer Environment: Power Apps (Canvas), Power Automate, Copilot Studio, Dataverse, SharePoint, SQL, Azure
Developed enterprise Canvas Apps with modular architecture, reusable components, and environment-based routing (Dev/UAT/Prod).
Built Power Automate flows integrating with backend systems using REST APIs, HTTP connectors, and on‑prem gateway.
Implemented webhooks and child flows with structured error handling, retry policies, and correlation IDs.
Designed Copilot Studio bots with topic design, generative answers, Dataverse/SharePoint connectors, and Teams escalation.
Applied prompt engineering techniques to generate flows, Power Fx expressions, and test payloads using Copilot.
Implemented ALM using managed solutions, environment variables, and Azure DevOps CI/CD pipelines.
Ensured governance and compliance using DLP policies, secure parameters, and connection references.
Optimized platform performance through delegation strategies, query shaping, and controlled data loading.
Boven Technologies Pvt Ltd — Software Engineer (Jun 2020 – Apr 2022) Project: PM Toolkit Role: Power Apps / CRM Developer Environment: Power Apps (Canvas), Power Automate, SharePoint, SQL
Developed task-based Canvas Apps with parameterized forms and execution workflows.
Built flows invoking SQL stored procedures with approvals and Teams/email notifications.
Used Copilot to scaffold screens, optimize Power Fx logic, and draft automation logic.
Created Copilot Studio topic drafts for FAQs and operational guidance.
Implemented solution packaging and documented deployment and rollback steps.
